skills.description: Analyze bounded Modbus samples and report communication, timing, signal, and raw-word evidence.
skills.short_description: Find problems in Modbus sample data
skills.default_prompt: Use $analyze-capture to inspect this bounded Modbus capture.

skills.description: Apply a batch of explicit Modbus map decisions while preserving evidence, exclusions, holds, and audit history.
skills.default_prompt: Use $apply-review to apply this batch of confirmed map decisions.

skills.description: Build a deterministic declarative text or CSV export from a documented example and canonical Modbus map.
skills.short_description: Build a declarative text or CSV export
skills.default_prompt: Use $build-custom-export to reproduce this documented export format.

skills.description: Build deterministic read-only artifacts for gavinying/modpoll or supported Witte Modbus Poll profiles.
skills.default_prompt: Use $build-modpoll to build artifacts for this Modpoll profile.

skills.description: Build deterministic read-only ModScan setup, poll-plan, point-map, and protocol test-message artifacts.
skills.short_description: Build a documented ModScan read plan
skills.default_prompt: Use $build-modscan to build a read-only ModScan setup.

skills.description: Build deterministic read-only Node-RED Modbus flow JSON from a canonical map and compiled read plan.
skills.short_description: Build a disabled Modbus read flow
skills.default_prompt: Use $build-node-red to build a disabled read-only Node-RED flow.

skills.description: Build any selected combination of Node-RED, Modpoll, and ModScan from one validated map and read plan.
skills.default_prompt: Use $build-tool-pack to build these selected target outputs.

skills.description: Create a bounded read-only probe that collects one raw Modbus sample through a selected target tool.
skills.default_prompt: Use $capture-sample to build a one-read probe for this point.

skills.description: Evaluate every supported byte and word layout from one immutable raw Modbus sample without choosing a winner.
skills.default_prompt: Use $check-byte-order to evaluate every layout for these raw words.

skills.description: Check a normalized Modbus map for identity, range, overlap, width, access, function, and byte-order problems.
skills.default_prompt: Use $check-map to validate this normalized Modbus map.

skills.description: Compare two reviewed Modbus maps and report added, removed, moved, changed, and unresolved points.
skills.default_prompt: Use $compare-maps to compare these reviewed register maps.

skills.description: Compile an OEM Modbus PDF or structured register map plus measurement intent into an organized user map, JSON, CSV, and optional target outputs in one resumable run.
skills.short_description: Compile an OEM map into ready user outputs
skills.default_prompt: Use $compile-user-map to turn this OEM map and measurement intent into organized user-map outputs.

skills.description: Extract traceable Modbus register candidates and page evidence from a bounded PDF manual or page range.
skills.short_description: Extract traceable rows from a PDF
skills.default_prompt: Use $extract-pdf-map to extract register rows from these PDF pages.

skills.description: Choose the next Modbus skill or short workflow from the user's goal and current artifact.
skills.short_description: Choose the next Modbus skill or path
skills.default_prompt: Use $modbus-help to choose the next skill for my goal.

skills.description: Normalize Modbus candidates into explicit offsets, areas, units, datatypes, widths, access, and byte-order states.
skills.default_prompt: Use $normalize-map to normalize these candidate register rows.

skills.description: Parse structured Modbus register maps into candidate rows with source values, rejected rows, assumptions, and holds.
skills.short_description: Parse a structured Modbus register map
skills.default_prompt: Use $parse-map to parse this register list into traceable candidates.

skills.description: Compile validated Modbus points into deterministic, bounded read blocks for function codes 01 through 04.
skills.default_prompt: Use $plan-reads to compile safe reads for this validated map.

skills.description: Preview and apply a known map-wide conversion between Modbus offsets and Modicon reference notation.
skills.default_prompt: Use $remap-addresses to preview this address-convention change.

skills.description: Review Modbus source evidence with automated checks and a grouped exception queue, avoiding page-by-page or row-by-row approval.
skills.default_prompt: Use $review-evidence to automate checks and group these source exceptions.

skills.description: Review a raw or messy Modbus register map through parsing, normalization, linting, and grouped evidence exceptions when source review itself is the requested outcome.
skills.short_description: Review a raw Modbus map end to end
skills.default_prompt: Use $review-map to review this raw register map without guessing.
